lines.text: You've carried this so long, the ache stopped surprising you.
Jesus doesn't wait for you to fix it first. He just says: come, exactly as you are.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart.
Not freedom from every yoke — a trade for His: fitted to you, carried at His pace, beside Him instead of alone.
For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
Set it down. Trade it. Find rest unto your soul. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Trade Your Yoke
story: A four-scene illustrated short film: a weary traveler bowed under an unseen weight on a dusk road, hands exchanging a worn yoke for a new one in firelit gold, a figure standing upright as cool night breaks into gold dawn with the old burden left behind, and a quiet green pastoral sunrise where a flock finally rests. A visual telling of Matthew 11:28-30 - trading the yoke that's crushing you for the one that was made to fit.
